name: Seishun Hajimemashita!
source:
Springtime of Life!

Let's enjoy our youth, full force!

In spring they became seniors in high school…on account of their parents the twins returned to the rural town that they once lived.

On the first day of school, they reunited with old friends. Soon after being reunited, after their long absence, their friends invited them to join a certain club.

It is……

"Seishun-bu"

There is only a year left before they graduate, and they established the club on a whim when they noticed that no club let them fully enjoy their youth. They decided to do everything "youth like" along with the other members of seishun-bu!…and it's activities.

The dear old town, a long-standing friend, meeting new friends.
Creating memories of youth in their short time together.
In a rural town surrounded by mountains and sea, now, a year to remember is about to begin.

If you play as Chitose you can go after the male characters romantically (Ouji, Heita, Kanade, Tarou, Rihito, and Haiji) and if you play as Chihaya you can go after the female characters romantically (Arisu, Kotori, and Yoshino). 

There are also friendship routes for same sex characters and Yukihiko.

[From [url=http://maplehoney01.tumblr.com/tagged/seishun%20hajimemashita!]maplehoney[/url]]
translation:
青春的季节！

让我们尽情享受青春吧！

春天，他们成为了高中三年级学生……因为父母的缘故，双胞胎回到了曾经生活过的乡下小镇。

开学第一天，他们与老朋友重逢了。久别重逢后不久，朋友们邀请他们加入某个社团。

那就是……

“青春部”

距离毕业只剩一年，他们发现没有一个社团能让他们充分享受青春，于是心血来潮成立了这个社团。他们决定和青春部的其他成员一起做所有“青春该做的事”！

怀念的老街、多年的老友、结识新朋友。在短暂的相处中创造青春的回忆。在一个被山海环绕的乡下小镇，一段值得铭记的一年即将开始。

如果你扮演千岁，可以攻略男性角色（王子、平太、奏、太郎、理人、海二）；如果你扮演千早，可以攻略女性角色（爱丽丝、小鸟、芳乃）。

还有同性角色和雪彦的友情路线。
